question: The headquarters of UN is located at:
solution:
The correct answer is __**New York City**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The headquarters of the **United Nations (UN)** is located in **New York City, USA**.
 
• The complex s**its along the East River in the Turtle Bay area of Manhattan.**
 
• While **New York hosts the main headquarters**, the UN also has major offices in Geneva (Switzerland), Vienna (Austria), and Nairobi (Kenya).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** United Nations (UN)**

 
 
• **​**The **United Nations (UN)** is an international organization founded in 1945, after World War II
 
• It was organised to promote peace, security, and cooperation among countries.
 
• The UN aims to prevent conflicts, foster international cooperation, and address global issues such as poverty, health, education, and human rights.
 
 
 
• The UN works with various specialized agencies and programs that focus on specific areas, such as:
 
 
• **World Health Organization (WHO)**: Addresses global health issues.
 
• **United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)**: Promotes education, science, and culture.
 
• **United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF)**: Focuses on the welfare of children and mothers.
